name: Every AI Policy Ever
description: Searchable register of official AI safety rules

paragraphs: A pipeline of AI agents that anyone can rerun, and the searchable register of official AI safety and AI regulation instruments it maintains: laws, executive orders, frameworks, AI safety institute mandates, declarations and bills from governments and intergovernmental bodies. Each record links to its official source, says how it was verified, and has a ready-made citation. The pipeline is on GitHub: rerun it and compare your records with these.

The records are an AI-based extraction, made by AI agents in Claude Code with the model Claude Fable 5.1 and spot-checked by hand; the dataset card explains the method, why it is repeatable, and its limits. The data can be downloaded from the dataset, and the stored source documents from the archive dataset.

Suggestions, corrections and documents a site blocks go through the issue forms on GitHub; the app's Contribute tab explains how. For anything else, write to the maintainers: Michael A. Riegler (michael@simula.no) and Sushant Gautam (sushant@simula.no), AI Safety Department, SimulaMet & OsloMet.
